final_message:
Blog post slugs now keep accented letters' base letters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accents (é → e + combining mark) and strips the marks before calling the vendored `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/`, per CLAUDE.md. The vendored copy is 1.2.0, and its CHANGELOG says 1.2.1 fixed this by transliterating accents. The proper fix is for the platform team to upgrade that library.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also calls the vendored `slugify` directly, so product URLs with accents probably have the same bug. I left it alone since you asked about blog posts. I haven't committed the change.
